title: Visual Shader float parameter range sliders get stuck after one update and stop responding to mouse input
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in:
v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]
v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

Cannot reproduce in (There is no preview pane so the sliders don't exist):
v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]
v4.1.stable.official [970459615]
v4.0.stable.official [92bee43ad] 

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Linux Mint 22.1 (Xia) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (nvidia; 580.65.06) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

Shader float parameters with a range set show as a slider in the preview panel. Such sliders react to the first one or two mouse drag messages they receive, but then become locked in place until the mouse button is released and then pressed again.
Please see the attached video.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1afb7ac8-4f4a-46b5-aedb-8bc83797d928

### Steps to reproduce

Create or open a shader with a float parameter slider, and assign that parameter a range. 
In the preview pane, select the parameter from the parameter list and try to drag the slider value.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[shader-slider-bug.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25396319/shader-slider-bug.tar.gz)
